title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 19
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'domino theory' of accident causation was proposed by
questions.solution: H.W. Heinrich proposed the domino theory.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'timber prop' in underground mines is used for
options: Temporary support of roof and floor
questions.solution: Timber props provide temporary support for roof and floor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'non-coking coal' is used for
questions.solution: Non-coking coal is used for power generation and heating.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'misfire' must be dealt with by
options: Leaving it until the next shift
A competent person following prescribed procedures
Any worker present at the face
questions.solution: By a competent person following procedures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar shall ensure that no person works
options: Under the influence of intoxicating substance
questions.solution: No person shall work under the influence of intoxicating substance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum permissible noise level for continuous exposure in mines is
questions.solution: Maximum 85 dB for continuous exposure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'sealed area' in a mine fire is created to
options: Isolate the fire area and deprive it of oxygen
questions.solution: Isolates fire area and deprives it of oxygen.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Man riding in underground mines is regulated by
questions.solution: Man riding in underground mines is regulated by CMR 2017 Regulation 142.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be examined by a competent person
options: At intervals prescribed by the manager
When the system fails to run
questions.solution: At intervals prescribed by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must check that the fire-fighting equipment
options: Is available and in working order
Is counted in the annual stock take
Is stored in the manager's office
questions.solution: Fire-fighting equipment must be available and in working order.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'exploration borehole' near old workings is done to
options: Investigate water conditions before mining approaches
questions.solution: Exploration boreholes investigate water conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'production working' in mining involves
questions.solution: Production working extracts coal from developed faces.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'post-rescue debriefing' covers
options: Lessons learned, equipment performance, and improvements
questions.solution: Debriefings cover lessons, performance, improvements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety measures against roof fall include
options: Proper support, regular inspection, and strata monitoring
questions.solution: Proper support, regular inspection, and strata monitoring.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the working place is freed from
options: Any danger before allowing persons to work
questions.solution: The working place must be freed from any danger.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The notice of accident under the Mines Act must be given to the inspector within
questions.solution: Within 24 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing pump selection' depends on
questions.solution: Pump selection depends on head, capacity, and material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The earliest stage of coal formation is
questions.solution: Peat is the earliest stage of coal formation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The power cable used in underground mines must have
questions.solution: Armored construction with flame-retardant properties.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding rope must be replaced if
options: Its diameter has reduced by more than the prescribed limit
questions.solution: Replacement is required if diameter reduction exceeds prescribed limit.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'retreating longwall' method involves
options: Extraction from the shaft area towards the boundary
A method used in metal mines only
Extracting coal from the boundary towards the shaft
questions.solution: Extracting coal from boundary towards shaft.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man winding engine and a material winding engine must
options: Be separate unless both are used with safety devices
Be operated by the same person
questions.solution: Separate engines unless both have proper safety devices.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cut shot' in coal mines is fired to
options: Create a free face for subsequent shots
questions.solution: Cut shots create a free face for subsequent production shots.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The stone dust barrier is used to
questions.solution: Stone dust barriers suppress coal dust explosion propagation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the route of travel
questions.solution: Routes of travel must be safe and properly maintained.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The joint survey plan showing workings near the common boundary with an adjacent mine shall be signed by:
options: The surveyors and managers of both the mine and the adjacent mine
The surveyor of the mine concerned
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 65(1)(e): the joint survey plan is signed by the surveyor and the manager of the mine and of adjoining mines whose workings come within 60 m of the common boundary.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'summary' of a report should be
options: A concise overview of key findings and recommendations
A full reproduction of the report
questions.solution: A concise overview of key findings and recommendations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Who must the sirdar inform immediately in case of a reportable accident?
questions.solution: The manager and DGMS must be informed immediately.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The carbon content in anthracite coal is typically
questions.solution: Anthracite has 80-95% carbon content.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sand stowing' method uses
options: Sand mixed with water to fill the goaf
questions.solution: Sand mixed with water to fill goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The primary purpose of stowing is to
options: Control subsidence and support the roof
questions.solution: Control subsidence and support the roof.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'barrier pillar' is left to
options: Separate different panels or protect main workings
questions.solution: Barrier pillars separate panels and protect main workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A powered roof support (chock) is used in
questions.solution: Used in longwall mining for face support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast pattern' in opencast mines is designed considering
options: Rock type, explosive, and desired fragmentation
questions.solution: Blast patterns consider geology, explosives, and fragmentation goals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation training' for miners includes
options: Understanding airflow, gas hazards, and emergency procedures
questions.solution: Training covers airflow, gas hazards, emergency procedures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'date and time' in a report are important for
options: Establishing the sequence of events and timeline
questions.solution: Establishing the sequence of events and timeline.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The portable electrical equipment in mines must be
options: Intrinsically safe or flameproof as per zone classification
questions.solution: IS or flameproof as per zone classification.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The accident investigation must be completed within
questions.solution: As prescribed by regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A water spray system is used in mines to
options: Suppress coal dust at the source
questions.solution: Water spray suppresses coal dust at the source.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'easier breakage' in drifting is achieved by
options: Proper drill pattern, burden, and spacing
questions.solution: Proper drill patterns achieve easier breakage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'total recordable injury frequency rate' (TRIFR) includes
options: Those accidents which result in death
The injuries causing loss of time
All recordable injuries including lost time, medical treatment, and restricted work
questions.solution: All recordable injuries including lost time, medical treatment, and restricted work.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'foam-based fire suppression' is effective for
options: Class A and B fires including coal and oil fires
questions.solution: Class A and B fires including coal and oil fires.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast timing diagram' shows
options: Sequence and timing of all detonators
questions.solution: Timing diagrams show the complete detonation sequence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue equipment storage' should be
questions.solution: Equipment must be stored in clean, dry, accessible location.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'misfire' in blasting refers to
options: A shot that fails to explode
questions.solution: A shot that fails to explode.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire extinguisher' types suitable for coal mines include
options: Dry chemical, foam, and CO2 types
questions.solution: Coal mines use dry chemical, foam, and CO2 extinguishers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing material testing' includes
options: A test of the pump colour
Grain size, strength, permeability, and compatibility
questions.solution: Material testing covers grain size, strength, permeability, and compatibility.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'photographic evidence' in a report helps to
options: Provide visual documentation of conditions and evidence
questions.solution: Provides visual documentation of conditions and evidence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing face' must be
options: Properly ventilated and maintained safe for workers
questions.solution: Properly ventilated and maintained safe.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ripping' in underground mining is done to
options: Increase the height of a gallery by removing roof or floor rock
questions.solution: Ripping removes roof or floor rock to increase gallery height.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'level instrument' must be checked for
options: Temporary adjustments - bubble, crosshair, and line of sight
questions.solution: Temporary adjustments - bubble, crosshair, and line of sight.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'medical examination' of mine rescue team members must be conducted
questions.solution: At regular intervals as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Carbon dioxide (CO2) in mines can accumulate in
options: Low-lying areas and poorly ventilated sections
The roof of the surface office
questions.solution: Low-lying areas and poorly ventilated sections.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The Mines Rescue Rules, 1985 deal with
options: The design of the mine buildings
Organization and training of mine rescue teams
The colour of the winding ropes
questions.solution: Organization and training of mine rescue teams.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'GPS survey' in mining provides
questions.solution: GPS surveys provide 3D positioning for surface surveys.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'near miss report' is important because
options: It helps identify potential hazards before actual accidents occur
questions.solution: Helps identify potential hazards before actual accidents occur.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Coal mine dust containing more than 5% silica is considered
options: Beneficial to the lungs of the workers
More hazardous as it can cause silicosis
questions.solution: More hazardous as it can cause silicosis.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cost of stowing' depends on
options: Material type, transportation distance, and equipment used
questions.solution: Material type, transportation distance, and equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The drill machine used in underground mines for face drilling is
questions.solution: Pneumatic or hydraulic drill machines are used.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'returns of accidents' must be maintained by
options: The manager as per prescribed format
questions.solution: The manager must maintain returns of accidents.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in mines includes
options: Helmet, safety lamp, self-rescuer, safety shoes, and protective clothing
questions.solution: Multiple PPE items are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sapropelic coal' is formed from
questions.solution: Sapropelic coal forms from algae and spores.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A dragline in open cast mining is used for
questions.solution: Strips overburden from large areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding vehicle must have its capacity marked as
questions.solution: Maximum capacity clearly marked.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pillar recovery' in depillaring involves
options: Systematic extraction of coal from pillars
questions.solution: Pillar recovery systematically extracts coal from pillars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must report to the manager if he finds that
options: There is a contravention of the Act or regulations
questions.solution: Any contravention of the Act or regulations must be reported.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support spacing' in underground mines is determined by
options: Load conditions, support capacity, and span
questions.solution: Support spacing depends on load, capacity, and span.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The emergency lighting in underground mines must be
options: Connected only to the main supply
Provided and operational in case of power failure
questions.solution: Provided and operational in case of power failure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An isolated stone dust barrier is installed
options: At specific intervals along the main and return airways
questions.solution: At specific intervals along main and return airways.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A mine rescue team member must be physically fit and
questions.solution: Between 21 and 40 years of age.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: DGMS circulars are
options: Mandatory instructions for compliance in mines
questions.solution: Mandatory instructions for compliance in mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'overhand stoping' method involves working
options: Along the dip of the seam
questions.solution: Working upward from a horizontal floor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire resistant materials' in mine construction include
questions.solution: Fire resistant materials include concrete, steel, treated timber.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The water-danger plan maintained under CMR 2017 shows water bodies existing within ______ of the boundary of the mine.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 65(1)(g): a water-danger plan and section show water bodies existing up to 200 m of the mine boundary.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team fitness' must be
options: The age of the member matters
Physically fit and medically cleared for rescue operations
questions.solution: Teams must be physically fit and medically cleared.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Water barriers are used to
options: Supress coal dust explosions by absorbing heat
questions.solution: Water barriers absorb heat and suppress explosions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal seam splitting' occurs when
options: A single seam divides into two or more seams
questions.solution: Seam splitting occurs when one seam divides into multiple.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hydraulic stowing pipeline' must be made of
options: Wear-resistant material to handle abrasive slurry
questions.solution: Pipelines must be wear-resistant for abrasive slurry.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'leakage' in ventilation occurs through
options: Distribute air to all working places
questions.solution: Ventilation leakage occurs through stoppings, doors, openings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine plan' is a
options: Scaled representation of mine workings on paper
questions.solution: Mine plans are scaled representations of workings.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
questions.solution: Indira Gandhi was the first woman PM.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine closure' planning involves
options: Environmental restoration, rehabilitation, and long-term monitoring
questions.solution: Mine closure planning covers environment, rehabilitation, monitoring.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'ash content' of coal affects
options: Its quality, price, and suitability for different uses
questions.solution: Affects quality, price, and suitability for uses.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'resettlement and rehabilitation' (R&R) policy for mining deals with
options: Displacement and rehabilitation of affected families
questions.solution: R&R policy deals with displacement and rehabilitation of affected families.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which river flows through the Grand Canyon?
questions.solution: Colorado River flows through the Grand Canyon.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Ujjwala Yojana' provides
options: Free LPG connections to BPL families
questions.solution: Free LPG connections to BPL families.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A table shows: Year 1 profit=50, Year 2=60, Year 3=75. What is the percentage increase from Year 1 to Year 3?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CIL's annual production' exceeded 600 MT in
questions.solution: Exceeded 600 MT in 2021-22.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal sector reforms' aim to
questions.solution: Increase competition and production efficiency.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A line graph shows temperature underground: 28, 30, 32, 35, 38°C over 5 months. What is the temperature increase?
questions.solution: 38-28 = 10°C increase.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Golden Temple is located in which city?
questions.solution: Golden Temple is in Amritsar, Punjab.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: India's literacy rate as per Census 2011 was approximately
questions.solution: India's literacy rate was 74.04% as per Census 2011.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which is the smallest planet?
questions.solution: Mercury is the smallest planet.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'National Safety Council (Mining)' promotes
options: Safety awareness and training in the mining sector
questions.solution: Safety awareness and training.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'explosive charge' in opencast mining depends on
options: Rock/coal properties, blast hole dimensions, and fragmentation requirements
questions.solution: Rock properties, hole dimensions, and fragmentation requirements.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The highest mountain peak in India is
questions.solution: Kangchenjunga is the highest peak in India.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'washability' of coal refers to
options: The ease with which it can be cleaned of impurities
questions.solution: Ease of cleaning impurities.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The capital of Jharkhand is
questions.solution: Ranchi is the capital of Jharkhand.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Car: 60km in 1.5hr. Speed in m/s?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'ECL' (Eastern Coalfields Limited) is headquartered in
questions.solution: ECL headquarters is in Kolkata.
